parsed.post: New personal best! 0.8626 -> 0.8444 by keeping DEPTH=6 and MATRIX_LR=0.05 but testing a smaller TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144. The extra optimizer steps clearly helped. Next, I'll test WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 to see if more warmup further stabilizes the training at this smaller batch size.
parsed.description: Halving batch size to 262144 to increase optimizer steps, combined with increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to see if more warmup stability allows for better convergence.
